customer_name: Wuhan Zhongwei Huitong Technology Co., Ltd. (中卫慧通)
business_problem: Zhongwei Huitong needed to help grassroots governments serve large resident populations with very small front-line teams, but manual information collection, repetitive consultation work, and complex work-order coordination limited service quality and responsiveness.
solution_summary: Zhongwei Huitong used the Qianfan AppBuilder platform, ModelBuilder, Workflow, and GBI capabilities to build a full grassroots-governance assistant stack for government customers. Resident-facing assistants operate through WeChat groups, mini-programs, official accounts, H5 pages, and personal-assistant interfaces, combining role instructions, speech recognition, online search, standard follow-up prompts, and local knowledge bases to answer public-service questions. On the government side, Zhongwei Huitong uses natural-language parsing plus standardized forms to turn巡查 and dispute-resolution notes into structured work orders, then Workflow automates creation, routing, review, feedback, and closure. Information-analysis workflows add data crawling, governance, archiving, sentiment extraction, and work-order dispatch logic. Together these pieces create a reusable SaaS platform where one model stack supports resident service, staff Copilot functions, knowledge management, and cross-step administrative execution for local-government customers.

solution_components.name: AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Powers resident-service assistants and local-government knowledge-base workflows across multiple service channels.

solution_components.name: ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports custom-model assembly for local administrative use cases and Copilot experiences.

solution_components.name: Workflow
solution_components.role: Automates work-order creation, routing, review, feedback, and completion for grassroots government processes.

solution_components.name: GBI
solution_components.role: Adds analytical insight capabilities on top of grassroots government service data and process flows.

data_flow: Resident questions enter through social and mini-program channels, AppBuilder responds from local policy knowledge or guarded online search, staff inputs are converted into structured work orders through natural-language parsing, and Workflow and GBI manage execution, dispatch, and insight generation across the service lifecycle.
business_outcome: Zhongwei Huitong improved the quality and efficiency of grassroots-government service delivery, reducing clerical burden for public servants while giving residents faster and more accurate answers around the clock.
metrics: resident service response speed improved by 30%
